channel.title: Tanzania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tanzania, every source cited.

item.title: Tanzania plans to cut state funding for public firms
item.description: A 25-year roadmap aims to make public corporations financially self-reliant, reducing dependence on government subsidies.

item.title: Tanzania joins 47 African nations in Moscow summit
item.description: Prime Minister Mwigulu Nchemba represented Tanzania at the Third Summit of Heads of State and Government discussing economic cooperation and security.

item.title: Tanzania and Angola sign four cooperation deals
item.description: Leaders aim to transform 50 years of solidarity into practical economic ties with new agreements.

item.title: Tanzania marks one year since deadly election unrest
item.description: Official figures state 518 people died and over 2,000 were injured in the October 29, 2025 events.

item.title: Tanzania accused of using laws to silence critics
item.description: Families of those killed in election violence demand justice and medical aid, while rights groups cite abuse of counterterrorism laws.
